name: Joan Lamburn
bio: A writer of children's stories, Louis Wilkinson's fourth and last wife, married after his divorce from Diana Bryn. She died in 1956, ten years before he did.
bio_note: The wedding is UNDATED; only her 1956 death has a year. The fourth marriage is footnoted on the article to Wilkinson's Times obituary. Louis Wilkinson married four times, was twice widowed and twice divorced. The Wikipedia article is footnoted PER MARRIAGE, which is why it is used here where Le Gallienne's is treated far more warily - Gregg to Bayley (1995) and Wilhelm (1990); the 1923 divorce to a T. S. Eliot letter of 9 February 1929; Ann Reid to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication and to Friedman (2002), with her 1932 death to Elwin (1946), p. 207; Diana Bryn to Who Was Who; Joan Lamburn to his Times obituary. Wikidata Q26435237 records only Gregg and is incomplete rather than contradictory. ONLY THE FIRST MARRIAGE AND THE FIRST DIVORCE CARRY DATES; the other three weddings are undated in everything read and are entered undated.
